title: Wolf and Monster by the Pond
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a black wolf with glowing yellow eyes standing on the left shore of a reflective pond, facing a large green monstrous creature with purple flowing hair and sharp teeth on the right. In the foreground sits a potted green plant, while a bright yellow sun bursts behind a pile of red geometric shapes in the center. Multiple floating eyes appear in the dark clouds above.
prompt: A surreal fantasy landscape with a black wolf with glowing eyes standing on the left bank of a calm pond, facing a large green monstrous creature with sharp teeth and flowing purple hair on the right.
